title: A LOCKED BUTTON SAYS WHY
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. At Wirt, GAMBLE and the offer BUY out of reach were dull grey buttons with nothing saying why. They now carry a small red chip with how much more they need, and the button stays readable.
now: At Wirt a button you cannot afford says how much more it needs.

edits.replacement:
lb.disabled=!afford;
    lb.style.opacity=1; lb.setAttribute('data-need',afford?'':('NEED $'+(WIRT_LOT_PRICE-P.credits).toLocaleString()+' MORE'));   // vNN.xx (ui5q2f): the reason chip
